title: Under the hugecloaked Liberator’s form.
html_source: This is the O'Connell Monument, erected as a memorial to Daniel O'Connell, the 19th century nationalist leader. It was sculpted by John Henry Foley, and stands at the entrance to the street bearing his (O'Connell’s) name. (in 1904 it was Lower Sackville Street.) Bloom’s carriage has crossed the Liffey and is proceeding up Sackville Street.
